summary: The game presents a clean neon HUD and a basic hilly street grid, but immediately fails on core gameplay and realism. The player spawns facing directly into a building corner and gets permanently wedged against the wall within 4 seconds. No opponent Waymos exist (likely due to an unfulfilled multiplayer connection), and pressing Space drains the laser capacitor without rendering any visible laser beams or effects. The city consists of untextured low-poly boxes with no San Francisco architectural details or landmarks.

top_issues.issue: No opponents exist in the world and firing the laser produces no visible beam or projectile.
top_issues.evidence: From 00:07 to 00:15 (and Screenshots 3-5), the 'LASER CAPACITOR' bar drains from 100% to 0% during Spacebar inputs, but no laser beam is rendered. The radar is completely empty and top-right HUD is stuck on 'CONNECTING...'.
top_issues.fix_hint: Spawn autonomous AI Waymo bots locally so the game works offline without a multiplayer server, and render a bright glowing cylinder/line mesh with hit particles when firing.

top_issues.issue: Poor spawn orientation and sticky wall collisions trap the vehicle immediately.
top_issues.evidence: In Screenshot 1 (00:01), the car spawns angled toward a building corner. By 00:04 (Screenshot 2), driving forward and turning wedges the car against the building wall where it remains stuck at 0-1 MPH until 00:15.
top_issues.fix_hint: Spawn the player car aligned with the center of a road lane, and implement smooth sliding wall collision response so cars deflect off buildings instead of snagging.

top_issues.issue: No recognizable San Francisco landmarks are visible anywhere in the scene.
top_issues.evidence: Across all screenshots (1-5) and the entire 15s video, only generic brown/grey rectangular blocks are visible against a pitch-black sky.
top_issues.fix_hint: Add iconic SF landmarks visible from the streets and hills, such as the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, Salesforce Tower, Transamerica Pyramid, or Sutro Tower on the horizon.

top_issues.issue: The environment looks like dark, untextured primitive boxes rather than realistic San Francisco streets.
top_issues.evidence: Comparing Screenshots 1-5 to the real Waymo SF camera photos: the game lacks daylight/fog atmosphere, Victorian bay windows, detailed building facades, trees/palms, overhead wires, traffic lights, and sidewalks.
top_issues.fix_hint: Switch to a bright daytime or foggy SF skybox, add procedural Victorian rowhouse geometry with bay windows, street trees, sidewalks, traffic signals, and PBR road/building materials.

top_issues.issue: The car is an overly boxy low-poly sedan rather than a sloped Jaguar I-PACE SUV with full Waymo sensor hardware.
top_issues.evidence: In Screenshots 1-5, the vehicle is made of 3-4 rectangular boxes with a glowing blue puck on top, missing the Jaguar I-PACE coupe silhouette, front fender/mirror sensor pods, wheels, and Waymo branding.
top_issues.fix_hint: Model the curved white Jaguar I-PACE SUV body with visible wheels, dark windows, the central spinning roof lidar cylinder, and the distinct side/corner camera and lidar pods.

top_issues.issue: No opponent Waymos exist in the world and no laser beams are visible when firing.
top_issues.evidence: From 00:07 to 00:15 (and Screenshots 3-5), the 'LASER CAPACITOR' bar drains from 100% down to 0% during Spacebar inputs, but no laser projectile or beam is rendered. The radar is completely empty and top-right HUD says 'CONNECTING...' (Screenshot 0 says 'Disconnected. Retrying...').
top_issues.fix_hint: Spawn local AI-controlled Waymo bots so the world is full of opponents even offline, and render a bright visible 3D laser beam/bolt with hit particles when Space is pressed.

top_issues.issue: The player car spawns angled toward a building corner and gets permanently stuck against walls on basic forward/turn inputs.
top_issues.evidence: At 00:01-00:04, pressing W drives straight into the building corner. From 00:05 to 00:15, the car is wedged against the building wall at 0-2 MPH and never escapes.
top_issues.fix_hint: Spawn the player car centered in a street lane aligned with the road direction, and add sliding wall collision resolution so cars glide along walls instead of snagging.

top_issues.issue: No recognizable San Francisco landmarks are visible anywhere in the scene.
top_issues.evidence: Across all video frames (00:00-00:15) and Screenshots 1-5, only generic flat-shaded brown and dark-blue boxes are visible.
top_issues.fix_hint: Model and place iconic SF landmarks visible from the streets, such as the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, Transamerica Pyramid, Salesforce Tower, Coit Tower, and cable cars.
